title: Address bound from a word limit
statement: Let a machine configuration have word limit $w\in\mathbb Z$ and space limit $s\in\mathbb N$. If $s\le w$ and $x<s$, then the integer address $x$ is valid, meaning $0\le x<s$, and its absolute value satisfies $|x|\le w$.
hypotheses_covered: space limit is at most the word limit
natural number x is less than the space limit
